notes: Printed: 'Whenever one or more Cats you control deal combat damage to a player, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment that player controls.' The opponent controls two legal targets, a Relic and a Charm. The controller chooses the target as the trigger goes on the stack (CR 603.3d, 601.2c) and picks the Charm: the Charm is destroyed, the Relic stays. With feline_sovereign_once_per_combat_damage_step (the Relic) and feline_sovereign_controller_chooses_no_target (NONE), every word of the ask is honoured; an engine that picked for its controller could not pass all three. The G1 probe once hid this ask (verification wave 1, packet A15): the scenario runner's combat op answered it unseen.
